reason: A DSH Web UI side panel that presents the current session workspace as a lazy-loaded, read-only file tree with basic directory metadata and refresh controls.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 右侧提供当前会话工作区的懒加载只读文件树，并显示文件类型、大小及目录信息。
summaries.en: Adds a lazy-loaded, read-only file tree for the current session workspace to the right side of the DSH Web UI, with file types, sizes, and directory details.

capabilities: Displays a read-only tree of the current session workspace
Reads directory entries, file names, types, paths, and sizes through local HTTP routes
Provides hidden-file toggling, manual refresh, and inline filesystem error display
